answer: Require every agent identity to be a vertex in a verified work graph: an agent only gains spending power after completing paid tasks attested by independent peers, like a terrace where each level demands proof of prior useful work. A sybil swarm then faces a prism of costs — stake locked per identity, reputation that cannot be transferred, and attestation fees — so spawning a thousand fake agents costs a thousand times the work, while one honest agent climbs cheaply.
